text:
Mirrors are no more silent,
+
+nor the adventurous dawn more furtive;
+
+beneath the moon, you are that panther
+
+we are permitted to glimpse from afar.
+
+Through the inscrutable workings of a divine
+
+decree, we seek you in vain;
+
+more remote than the Ganges and the sunset,
+
+yours is the solitude, yours the secret.
+
+Your back condescends to the lingering
+
+caress of my hand. You have admitted,
+
+from that eternity which is now oblivion,
+
+the love of the wary hand.
+
+You inhabit another time. You are master
+
+of a realm enclosed like a dream.

translation.title: Mirrors Are No More Silent…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
